main.description: A physical location in the form of a WGS84 coordinate.

latitude.description: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees as a string (AT Proto has no floats). South of the equator is negative. Do not use DMS.

longitude.description: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees as a string. West of the prime meridian is negative.

altitude.description: Optional altitude in meters above mean sea level, as a string.
